result:
The failing test is fixed locally (41/41 passing, three runs in a row), but nothing is committed or pushed yet, so the pipeline itself is still red until you push.

- **Cause:** Commit 741337d moved `_lookups++` out of the `lock (Gate)` block in `PriceCache.GetOrAdd`. The increment is not atomic, so parallel lookups lost updates (124 instead of 128). It is a real race in the code, not a runner-04 problem.
- **Action:**
  - `src/Storefront/Pricing/PriceCache.cs`: the lookup counter now uses `Interlocked` for increment, read and reset. Price resolution still happens outside the lock.
  - `src/Storefront/Checkout/CheckoutService.cs`: the invoice number now uses `Interlocked.Increment`. On my first local run after the cache fix, `Checkout_NumbersInvoicesUniquely_WhenCheckoutsRunInParallel` failed (63 of 64 unique) because `_nextInvoiceNumber++` has the same kind of race. That race predates this MR and would have kept the pipeline flaky.

One thing the MR changes that I left alone: two parallel misses on the same SKU can now both call `resolve()`. No test covers it; say if you want resolve-once per SKU restored.
